# Ouroboros

> Ouroboros is the specification-first Agent OS for replayable, observable, policy-bound AI coding workflows.

## Canonical resources

- Website: https://ouroboros.page/
- Korean beginner guide: https://ouroboros.page/learn/
- Core repository and documentation: https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros
- Getting started: https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md
- Runtime guides: https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/tree/main/docs/runtime-guides
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/ouroboros-ai/
- Ourocode shell: https://github.com/Ouro-labs/ourocode
- Plugin ecosystem: https://github.com/Ouro-labs/ouroboros-plugins

## Version scope and installation

The English and Korean guides identify Ouroboros 0.51.5 and upstream d103058fe as their reference. Installed CLI packages, host plugins, and MCP servers can have different versions. Check the installed version and the product repository's current installation and command documentation before applying instructions.

That historical scope applies to the original `/learn/` guides, not to every page under `/docs/`. The first-task quickstarts and AI troubleshooting manual identify their own product-source and release boundaries, including main `592c667f` and release `0.59.9`. Follow the source revision stated on the page you read; do not apply historical `722172ef` detail-page behavior to a current-source instruction without comparison. The canonical repository's legacy `content/llms.txt` uses a different set of relative paths and is not this public index.

- Getting started and installation: https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md
- CLI reference: https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/main/docs/cli-reference.md
- Seed guide (Korean; reviewed against product main 592c667f): https://ouroboros.page/docs/seed-guide/
- Quickstart, including the separate plugin and CLI paths (Korean): https://ouroboros.page/docs/quickstart/

The product AI index and full context linked below currently state that an Interview automatically creates a Seed. Do not rely on that claim. In the supported host conversation, complete the Interview and confirm the goal, then request `ooo seed` in the same conversation; inspect the actual Seed YAML before execution, using the returned path if saved, and check its goal, constraints, and acceptance criteria. The standalone CLI has a separate flow; follow the quickstart and check the installed version. Host behavior and installed versions may differ from the referenced source.

The correction proposed at https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/pull/2916 is an open, unmerged draft; it has not corrected product main yet.

- Product AI index (see caveat above): https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/main/llms.txt
- Full product AI context (see caveat above): https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/main/llms-full.txt

## First-task guides in English and Chinese

These are partial draft translations: the quickstarts describe the first task, and the short troubleshooting pages cover selected status, evaluation and recovery steps. Broader detail remains in Korean. The guides cite product source `592c667f` for current-source portions and `722172ef` for historical details; installed CLI, plugin, server and release versions may differ. The site pages are generated from the separate canonical documentation source, and each page states its own verification limits.

## Core loop

Interview -> Seed -> Execute -> Evaluate -> Wonder -> Reflect -> next Seed

Ouroboros exposes assumptions before implementation, crystallizes intent into a Seed, executes through a replayable contract, evaluates outcomes, and feeds evidence into the next generation.

## Boundary

Ouroboros is an open-source developer tool. It is not affiliated with any cryptocurrency, memecoin, trading project, or similarly named token.
